answer: The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
